title: backlog.py next and brief run a ready story's checks with no recursion guard, so a check that runs next recurses
goal: backlog.py next and brief judge the no-worker line without re-entering themselves: a story check that runs next or brief is run at most once per call (or not at all from a read command), and a read command writes no test.run row for it

run:
import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib, os
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t / '_backlog'; d.mkdir()
c = t / 'count'
def w(o): (d / (o['id'] + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(o))
w({'id': 'SP-aaaaaaaa', 'kind': 'sprint', 'title': 's', 'status': 'active', 'goal': 'g'})
inner = ("import os,subprocess,sys;p=os.environ['RC'];n=len(open(p).read()) if os.path.exists(p) else 0;open(p,'a').write('x');"
         "n<3 and subprocess.run([sys.executable,os.environ['RB'],'--root',os.environ['RR'],'next','--all'],capture_output=True)")
w({'id': 'ST-ggggggg2', 'kind': 'story', 'title': 'story', 'status': 'todo', 'sprint': 'SP-aaaaaaaa', 'priority': 'P3', 'rank': 0,
   'goal': 'g', 'checks': [{'run': ['python3', '-c', inner]}]})
w({'id': 'TK-gggggga1', 'kind': 'task', 'title': 'task', 'status': 'done', 'parent': 'ST-ggggggg2', 'priority': 'P3', 'rank': 0, 'goal': 'g'})
env = dict(os.environ, RC=str(c), RR=str(t), RB=os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py'))
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', '--root', str(t), 'next', '--all'], capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=300)
n = len(c.read_text()) if c.exists() else 0
print('check runs of one next call:', n); sys.exit(0 if n <= 1 else 1)

import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
tools = os.path.abspath("_tools")
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t / "_backlog"; d.mkdir()
q = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
w = lambda o: (d / (o["id"] + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(o))
w({"id": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "sprint", "title": "s", "status": "active", "goal": "g"})
inner = "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, " + json.dumps(tools) + "); import tests; tests.record_run(\"keyword\", {\"exit\": 0, \"ms\": 1, \"files\": {}}, [])"
w({"id": "ST-ggggggg2", "kind": "story", "title": "story", "status": "todo", "sprint": "SP-aaaaaaaa", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "g", "checks": [{"run": ["python3", "-c", inner]}]})
w({"id": "TK-gggggga1", "kind": "task", "title": "task", "status": "done", "parent": "ST-ggggggg2", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "g"})
(q / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps({"mode": "local"}))
env = dict(os.environ, KB_TEST_RUN_HOME=str(q))
env.pop("PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST", None)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(tools, "backlog.py"), "--root", str(t), "next", "--all"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=300)
rows = [p for p in q.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "test.run" in p.read_text(errors="replace")]
print("test.run rows written by one next call:", len(rows), "| exit", r.returncode)
sys.exit(1 if rows or r.returncode else 0)
